about: The map's own effects (issue #437): pay_dun00's ten torches (EF_TORCH, emit speed 125) each fire every 125 ticks (2.0 s) while the player is under 26 cells away. Standing by the first (111, 149) for 4.5 s fires twice or more; at 40, 25 (over 30 cells from any torch) nothing fires for 3 s; coming back fires at once (its period has long passed). The torch has no look yet, so this reads the timers' counts.
